name: gui_build_E
description: GB-1 target E (ray-traced mask), from File > New Project > Blank with Studio's GUI only, on the Graph tab. As gui_build_B: the palette adds a render.material_pass of deferred_geometry_v1 (its G-buffer images), and Add Object > Cube and Add Object > Floor (a board under the box) give it something to draw and something to cast a shadow on. UX-5d, decision 2: the palette's render.compute row asks the engine for its shader list (get_engine_shaders, only when the row is picked) and offers the engine's ray tracing pipelines beside the project's compute shaders; engine://rt_shadow_mask_pipeline (ray tracing) is picked, and the task arrives tracing with its raygen, miss and closesthit, with the ports its shader declares: world_position and normal read from the material pass's worldpos and normal outputs (matched by name), shadow_mask written into an image of its own beside it (R8_UNORM, the format the engine reads from the shader, EL-4c), and the rays as many as that image's pixels (dispatch.rays_from). It needs a device with ray-tracing pipelines. The task's shadow_mask output dragged onto present's + input is taken: the frame plan runs the trace after the material pass and before present (RS-6), and the viewport shows the mask: not the gradient, and the floor left of the box -- in the box's shadow -- is not the value of the lit floor right of it. Typed: the project folder and the name gb_e in New Project, and material_pass and render.compute in the palette's filter.
